messages:
Anya: quick heads-up — ran a tiny sweep focused on small-batch decode cold starts with the paged-attention + FlashAtt-fused variants. hitting 2x latency spikes on cold KV page swaps for N<=4. repro script below and raw numbers inline.

Anya: repro command i ran:
```
./bench_decode --model gptx-3b-q2 --kernels flash-fused,flash-unfused,paged --seq 32 --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 --kv-page-size 64 --warmup 5 --iters 50
```

Matt: can you paste the perf counters / top stack? curious if the stalls are GPU memcopy or kernel launch overheads. also which CUDA + cuBLAS? :thinking_face:

Anya: perf snippet (nvprof-like) from one cold run (batch=2, paged):
```
GPU memcpy HtoD: 1.2ms
launch overhead (kernel A fused_attn): 0.45ms
launch overhead (kernel B kv_page_load): 0.9ms
fused_attn runtime: 0.8ms
paged_attention runtime: 0.6ms
-- observed stall where kv_page_load + kernel launch serialize, causing ~1.6ms extra per token at start
```

Sara: hmm looks like KV page extraction + immediate fused kernel launch serialize. with continuous batching we can try coalescing the KV loads earlier (preload policy) or widen the small-batch decode fastpath to avoid paged load on warmups.

Anya: i tried toggling `kv_cache_policy=lazy` -> `eager_preload` in the runtime config for N<=4 and reran:
- baseline (paged + fused): median decode latency batch=2 = 12.1ms/token
- after eager_preload: median decode latency batch=2 = 8.9ms/token
- flash-unfused (no fused kernel): 9.6ms/token

Anya: so eager_preload recovers most of the hit, but we still have an odd launch serialization with fused kernel on cold path.

perf-bot: regression alert: decode_p50 for org/team/guest saw +22% vs yesterday in nightly perf run. trace: http://ci.internal/traces/1798502468

Matt: can you microprofile kernel launches? suspect we have a kernel selection hotpath that picks fused only after checking kv-page flags, and that check forces a synchronous memcpy on first access. if so, small-batch decode heuristic should prefer unfused for first few tokens, then switch to fused after KV warmed.

Anya: good call. added micro-instrumentation (timestamp on enqueue/complete) and saw a sync point inside select_kernel_for_seq() on first token where `page_dirty` check calls `cudaMemcpyAsync` + `cudaStreamSynchronize` in some codepaths — will open a patch.

Matt: +1 for heuristic: if batch_size <= 4 and token_idx < 6, force kernel=flash-unfused, else proceed with fused/paged heuristic. fallback to unfused on timeout. keep numbers in config so we can tune.

Sara: also add metric tags: `kv_swap_cause=page_fault|eviction` + `kernel_choice=forced-unfused|auto-fused` so ops can filter traces.

Anya: ran the heuristic locally (patch attached) — results:
- batch=1 p50 before: 18.3ms -> after: 13.6ms (26% improvement)
- batch=4 p50 before: 11.7ms -> after: 9.4ms (20% improvement)
- long sequences (>128) unaffected beyond warmup

Anya: will push a canary tomorrow AM to eng-runtime-canary with: forced-unfused for first 6 tokens when batch<=4, eager_preload enabled, and extra metric tags. will include quick revert (disable heuristic) and fallback policy to auto-fused if we see regressed throughput.

Matt: sounds good. please include the perf traces (micro timestamps + nvprof) in the canary run so we can confirm the serialization disappears. :thumbsup:

Sara: note to rollout checklist: add canary dashboard panel, alert if decode_p99 increases >10% or token-throughput drops >5%, and opt-in experiment label.

Anya: ack — will update PR with docs + canary dashboard link. thanks y'all.
